integrity: Eight standalone UTF-8 text files are embedded with per-file length and SHA-256 in the private envelope; Python standard-library verifier is illustrative and is not the asymptotic proof. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer number of shores r>=3 and shore size n approaching infinity; only primitive period-two orbits, not basins, other periods, unequal parts, or increasing r. The general two-cycle characterization is known; the new asserted contribution is the multivariate Gaussian limit and orbit-growth constant.
title: Gaussian firing populations in balanced complete multipartite sandpiles
